source: Categories and services follow the capitecbank.co.za personal and business menus. Service durations, prerequisites, opening hours and pool sizes are assumptions for testing; the branch itself comes from appointments.branch.

categories.name: Transact
categories.description: Everyday banking: accounts, cards and the Capitec app

services.name: Open an account
services.description: Open a transactional account; bring your ID
prerequisites: Your green barcoded ID book or Smart ID card
Proof of address not older than 3 months

services.name: Switch to Capitec
services.description: Move your salary and debit orders to Capitec
prerequisites: Your green barcoded ID book or Smart ID card
Your old bank's account number
Your employer's details for the salary switch

services.name: Card replacement
services.description: Replace a lost, stolen or damaged bank card
prerequisites: Your green barcoded ID book or Smart ID card
A case number if the card was stolen

services.name: Capitec app help
services.description: Get the app set up or solve an app problem
prerequisites: Your phone with the Capitec app installed
Your card and its PIN

services.name: Stokvel account
services.description: Open and manage a stokvel account
prerequisites: ID documents of the signatories
The stokvel's constitution or minutes naming the signatories

services.name: Access Anytime savings
services.description: Open a savings plan you can access any time

services.name: Fixed-term savings
services.description: Lock in a fixed interest rate for a fixed term
prerequisites: Your green barcoded ID book or Smart ID card
Your Capitec account for the deposit

services.name: Notice deposit
services.description: Earn more interest with a notice period

services.name: Tax-free savings
services.description: Save tax-free within the annual limit
prerequisites: Your green barcoded ID book or Smart ID card
Your income tax number, if you have one

services.name: Invest with EasyEquities
services.description: Start investing through EasyEquities

services.name: Funeral cover
services.description: Take out or change funeral cover
prerequisites: Your green barcoded ID book or Smart ID card
ID numbers of the family members to cover

services.name: Life cover
services.description: Take out or change life cover

services.name: Burial repatriation
services.description: Add burial repatriation to your cover

services.name: Insurance claim
services.description: Submit a funeral or life cover claim
prerequisites: Your green barcoded ID book or Smart ID card
The certified death certificate
The deceased's ID document
Bank details of the person claiming

services.name: Access facility

Your latest payslip

Your 3 latest payslips
Bank statements of the last 3 months
The offer to purchase, if you have one

services.name: Vehicle loan

Your driver's licence

services.name: Home improvement loan

services.name: Medical loan

Proof of address for RICA

categories.name: Home Affairs
categories.description: Smart ID and passport applications at Smart ID branches

services.name: Smart ID card application
services.description: Apply for a Smart ID card; book in advance
prerequisites: Your green barcoded ID book or birth certificate
The application fee (free for a first ID at 16)

services.name: Passport application
services.description: Apply for a South African passport
prerequisites: Your green barcoded ID book or Smart ID card
The application fee
Parents' IDs and unabridged birth certificate for children under 16
